With an objective to ensure ease of obtaining Motor TP liability only policy, insurers are advised to follow the following vis-8-vis issuance of Third Party insurance coverage: 

- (1) Insurers shall make available to the proposers, on-line channel as well, to 

   - obtain Motor Third Party liability only policy.
